description: The typed layer of a category, 10 products per call (page with offset, narrow with ids and keys) — every item with every value (number, canonical unit, bound, measurement condition, datasheet source page, confidence L0/L1) plus the property dictionary grouped by interface port (perf/power/data/mech/thermal/env/supply) — for arbitrary comparison, budgeting or trade studies on your side.

category.description: component class — ONE per call; for several classes call once per class (default reaction-wheels)

confidence.description: pass L1 to get only human-verified rows

keys.description: only these properties (prop_key values from properties), e.g. ["mass_g","momentum_nms"]

name: get_component_specs
